chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Mrs. Holloway, Asbury Park, Leroy's, and June Clark
summary: Basie confirms lessons with Mrs. Holloway, summers in Asbury Park and playing at Leroy's in New York, but says he never worked with Elmer Snowden.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit

blocks.x: Okay, this is something different. It says, "Later concentrated on piano, regular lessons from local teacher, Mrs. Holloway." She was the one who was later on, in high school? No. Grade school? Just a private teacher. "Some tuition from Fats Waller. Worked summers in Asbury Park." Is that so?
"And then played at Leroy's in New York." Ah-hah, so that's where you were playing?
All right, played at Leroy's. Was that the only club you played at? Briefly, you were with June Clark's band and Elmer Snowden. Was that at Leroy's?
It says here, "Played at Leroy's in New York," and in the same sentence, "briefly with June Clark's band and Elmer Snowden."
Now, (inaudible) other things what do the say -- did Feather's thing say that you played with June Clark's band in Harlem?

Okay. "Then began long spell of show with -- then began long spell of touring theaters, accompanying variety acts." That's a (inaudible). That's from my cigarette holder, which I left, okay. So you were touring theaters and accompanying variety acts, ah-hah. Kate Krippen and her Kids --
